DiscoveredInstrument#

class DiscoveredInstrument(
resource: str,
idn: str,
category: str,
driver_name: str,
num_channels: int | None = None,
transport: str = 'visa',
backend: str | None = None,
serial_config: SerialConfig | None = None,
)[source]#

Bases: object

An instrument that discovery identified and matched to a registered driver.

The record is enough to construct the driver (make_driver()) or to emit the driver block of an instro JSON config (config_block()), so scripts and fixtures don’t re-derive either from the resource string.

Variables:

  • resource (str) – Address the driver opens: a VISA resource string, or for other transports whatever the driver’s constructor takes (an NI-DAQmx device name, an MCC serial number, …).

  • idn (str) – Identity reply the match was made from (the raw *IDN? string for SCPI instruments).

  • category (str) – Instrument category ("psu", "dmm", "daq", …).

  • driver_name (str) – Key of the matched driver in the category’s registry (driver_registry()), e.g. "BK9115".

  • num_channels (int | None) – Programmable channel count where the category tracks it, else None.

  • transport (str) – "visa" for SCPI-over-VISA instruments. Discovery providers for vendor SDKs set their own token; only "visa" records can build a VisaConfig.

  • backend (str | None) – pyvisa backend the scan was asked for (None for the default with fallback), so visa_config() resolves it the same way the scan did.

  • serial_config (SerialConfig | None) – Serial settings a serial (ASRL) instrument answered with, else None.

Example:

report = scan_visa_resources()
psu = next(i for i in report.instruments if i.category == "psu")
instro_psu = InstroPSU(name="psu", driver=psu.make_driver(), num_channels=psu.num_channels)

property driver_class_name: str#

Deprecated alias of driver_name.

visa_config() → VisaConfig[source]#

The VisaConfig that reaches this instrument, carrying the backend and serial settings it answered with.

Raises:

ValueError – the instrument is not on the VISA transport.

driver_class() → type[source]#

The matched driver class, loaded from the category’s driver registry on demand.

Raises:

KeyError – driver_name is not registered for category.

make_driver() → Any[source]#

A new, unopened driver for this instrument.

VISA instruments get a VisaConfig; drivers on other transports receive resource directly, which is the device_id convention the DAQ vendor drivers use.

config_block() → dict[str, Any][source]#

The driver block of an instro JSON config for this instrument.

num_channels is included when discovery knows it, which is exactly the set of categories whose driver config requires it (psu, scope, awg).

Raises:

ValueError – the instrument is not on the VISA transport, which is the only one with a JSON config schema today.
